items.title: Buzzy Williams Interview, 1980-06-18
items.q: He built that building... I'm going around the steps and go do my business. And when I come back, he's coming down the stairs. So, boom!

ctx.x: For me. For me. For me. For me. For me. For me. For me. For me. For me. For me. For me. For me. For me. For me. Well, I got friends coming from Chicago, going to Paris, blah, blah, blah. So I'm the only guy in New York in them days who could work seven days. So we're working at Leslie House. It's called the Blair House now on West 56th Street. Unless they change the name again. Harry K. Thor, what's his name? Harry K. Thor.

He built that building. And about the third night, I don't drink on the job. I'm telling the truth. He wouldn't stand for it. I never did the last one. But I had to go. I'm going around the steps and go do my business. And when I come back, he's coming down the stairs. So, boom!
